items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think I did about two records with him, with Buster Williams and Billy Hart.

ctx.x: Oh, I’ve played with Buck Hill.
Yeah, Buck is – but the general public doesn’t really know that much about him. Kimery: [?] mailman.

Your mailman. Right. He’s incredible. We did – I did – I think I did about two records with him, with Buster Williams and Billy Hart. Wow. Because Billy Hart was the one who was instrumental in getting it to happen.
